title: Continuous rational coefficient inclusion
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $E,F$ finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with their specified spectral topologies [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $i:E\to F$ be a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding and $X$ a scheme with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Define the morphism $E_X\to F_X$ of continuous-function coefficient sheaves by the canonical continuous coefficient map [def-sfb-continuous-coefficient-pullback-maps] for $\operatorname{ULift}(i)$. On each site object $U$, it sends a continuous function $b$ to the function $x\mapsto i(b(x))$, with the standard universe lifts. The continuity proof is the uniqueness of the extended absolute value on finite extensions. This definition is the existing rationalBalancedCoefficient, and includes no scalar-realization comparison theorem.
